deviations_from_card: Case 4 dropped per revision (6 acceptance cases). Coupled files outside write_set: apps/console/src/perf/harness.tsx (+live.open/live.push broadcast helper) and apps/console/src/perf/commits.test.tsx (pushes to every open live subscription): the guard pushed to sockets.last(), which is now the app-wide stream since On Air's effect runs before DataProvider.start. apps/console/budgets/bundle.json (shared, under lock, own commit 66ea6fa): onair.l2 js 101,000 -> 101,500, measured about 100,860 B at HEAD -> 101,283 B. Tests and implementation landed in one commit (tests reference liveFeed/reset/markGap that did not exist). The card's openReplay is untouched (still zero consumers). LiveFeed applies frames as they come (the socket already drops replayed seq); seq is used only to clear the gap flag; reset() on each new subscription makes the scene the fold from seq 1.
notes: feed.ts now exports liveFeed (read-only Feed) for tests; FeedSnapshot gains optional gap. Subscription keyed on (mounted, source.kind==='live'), not on active, so a nested On Air page keeps the fold. Slot B (replay scrub) builds on feed.ts/player.ts after this: LiveFeed.seek should be a no-op beside reset/markGap. Untracked packages/stage-kit/nul and other litter predate this build and are not mine.
